scenes.name: Hook
scenes.visual: Warm paper background. Big serif headline types on. A phone floats up from below with the Home screen.
scenes.motion: Headline word-by-word reveal (0-3s). Phone rises with a soft shadow and a 3-degree tilt that settles flat (3-6s). Slow push-in on the greeting.
text: Two minutes. That's all it takes.
scenes.vo: Hey! How often do you pick up your phone? What if just two minutes of it made you sharper... and even paid you back?
scenes.sfx: Soft whoosh on phone rise; a single warm chime on 'paid you back'.

scenes.name: Meet Curi
scenes.visual: Curi wordmark and app icon centre-stage, then the otter pops in beside the phone with a speech bubble.
scenes.motion: Logo scales in with a gentle overshoot. Landing hero slides in from the right; zoom to the headline. Otter bounce-in with a wave.
text: One word. One fact. Every day.
scenes.vo: Meet Curi. Every day, you get a fresh word and a fun fact. Two minutes, no pressure, and an otter cheering you on.
scenes.sfx: Pop on the logo; a friendly 'boing' when the otter lands.

scenes.name: Weekly prizes (emotional high point)
scenes.visual: Dark 'night' scene. The podium rises, then the three prize amounts light up in turn. Calendar tile shows Monday.
scenes.motion: Podium blocks rise 2nd, 3rd, then 1st. Amounts count up: ₦1,000 then ₦1,500 then ₦2,500 (gold glow on first place). Confetti burst on N2,500. End with a Monday calendar flip and the line 'Resets every Monday'. Do NOT show 'winner' names or payouts as if they have happened.
scenes.vo: And here is the best part. Every week, the top three win real cash. Second place: one thousand five hundred naira. Third place: one thousand naira. And first place wins two thousand five hundred naira! It resets every Monday, starting the sixteenth of November.
scenes.sfx: Deep riser into the podium rise; coin/shimmer on each amount; celebratory hit and confetti pop on ₦2,500; a calendar 'flip' on Monday. Music swells here, then settles.
